Create a Custom Button for Shiny UI

Source: R/ro_shiny_create_custom_button.R
ro_create_custom_button.Rd

Generates a Shiny action button with an SVG icon and custom label text.

Usage

ro_create_custom_button(input_id, label_text, svg_path)

Arguments

input_id

Character. The input ID for the action button.

label_text

Character. The label to display next to the icon.

svg_path

Character. SVG path data for the icon.

Value

A Shiny tag list representing the action button UI element.

See also

ro_icon_download, ro_icon_table

Other DT: ro_icon_download(), ro_icon_table(), ro_shiny_download_server(), ro_shiny_download_ui(), ro_shiny_dt_responsive(), ro_shiny_dt_server(), ro_shiny_dt_ui(), ro_shiny_graph_panel_server(), ro_shiny_graph_panel_ui(), ro_shiny_screenreader(), ro_show_table_server(), ro_show_table_ui()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ro_create_custom_button(
  input_id = "download_btn",
  label_text = "Download",
  svg_path = ro_icon_download()
)
} # }
